project.name: cavet
project.description: A Go CLI security-triage tool for coding agents. It runs scanners (trivy, opengrep, gitleaks, checkov) inside an offline container engine and records every finding and decision in an append-only audit log.
project.context: This finding comes from a scan of the cavet repository itself.

finding.description:
The package cache was not deleted after running 'apt-get update', which increases the size of the image. Remove the package cache by appending '&& apt-get clean' at the end of apt-get command chain.
verdict: dismissed (high confidence, by operator): the RUN block starting engine/Dockerfile:18 ends at line 23 with rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*; the package cache is deleted in the same layer, the rule anchored on the apt-get update line and missed it

mechanical_context.path_class: container image build definition (shipped as the scanner engine image)
mechanical_context.source_excerpt:
12 | ARG OPENGREP_RULES_SHA=f1d2b562b414783763fd02a6ed2736eaed622efa
   13 | 
   14 | # ---------------------------------------------------------------- base ------
   15 | FROM debian:bookworm-slim AS base
   16 | # -y upgrade: the base snapshot's debs go stale between releases (e.g. libexpat1
   17 | # CVE-2026-56408); upgrade picks up every fixed deb security update at build time.
   18 | RUN apt-get update && apt-get -y upgrade \
   19 |     && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
   20 |         locales git ca-certificates curl \
   21 |     && sed -i 's/^# *C.UTF-8 UTF-8/C.UTF-8 UTF-8/' /etc/locale.gen \
   22 |     && locale-gen \
   23 |     && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
   24 | # Opengrep aborts with UnicodeDecodeError under a non-UTF-8 locale (spike §6).
